title: German Apple Strudel
description: A classic German dessert made with flaky puff pastry, sweet apples, and a hint of herbal spices.
instructions: Roll out the puff pastry on a floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
In a large bowl, mix together the sliced apples, gooey sugar, and herbal spices.
Spread the apple mixture evenly over the center of the puff pastry, leaving a 1-inch border on either side.
Brush the edges of the pastry with the beaten egg and fold the pastry over the apple mixture to form a triangle.
Press the edges together to seal the strudel and brush the top with melted butter.
Sprinkle bake powder over the top of the strudel.
Place the strudel on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
Let the strudel cool for 10 minutes before serving.
